title: Lightweight Time-Frequency Vibration Sensing for Consumer Device Condition Monitoring
abstract: arXiv:2610.13040v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Consumer rotating devices, including washing machines, air conditioners, electric fans, robotic vacuum cleaners, and home fitness equipment, increasingly rely on vibration sensing for intelligent condition monitoring and predictive maintenance. Ensuring reliable operation in these resource-constrained appliances requires efficient, lightweight artificial intelligence (AI) solutions capable of processing non-stationary signals under real-world operational interference. This paper proposes a lightweight AI-assisted vibration sensing framework that employs continuous wavelet transform (CWT) and Hilbert-Huang transform (HHT) to convert one-dimensional (1-D) vibration time-series signals into two-dimensional (2-D) time-frequency representations. These representations are subsequently analyzed using lightweight deep learning architectures, specifically MobileNetV3-Small, ConvNeXt-Tiny, and the You Only Look Once version 11 classification mod

translated_title: 面向消费设备状态监测的轻量级时频振动感知
translated_abstract: 包括洗衣机、空调、电风扇、扫地机器人和家用健身器材在内的消费级旋转设备，越来越依赖振动传感来实现智能状态监测与预测性维护。要确保这些资源受限的电器可靠运行，需要高效的轻量级人工智能（AI）解决方案，能够在真实运行干扰下处理非平稳信号。本文提出了一种轻量级的AI辅助振动感知框架，该框架采用连续小波变换（CWT）和希尔伯特-黄变换（HHT）将一维振动时间序列信号转换为二维时频表示，随后利用轻量级深度学习架构对这些表示进行分析，具体包括MobileNetV3-Small、ConvNeXt-Tiny以及You Only Look Once第11版（YOLOv11）分类模型。
tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级AI振动感知框架，通过CWT和HHT将一维振动信号转换为二维时频表示，并借助MobileNetV3-Small等轻量级深度学习模型进行分析，实现消费类旋转设备在真实干扰下的智能状态监测与预测性维护。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a lightweight AI-assisted vibration sensing framework that converts 1-D vibration signals into 2-D time-frequency representations via CWT and HHT, analyzed by lightweight deep learning models such as MobileNetV3-Small for consumer device condition monitoring and predictive maintenance under real-world interference.
